title: Name a set of cases
summary: F#: Name a set of cases. Change light to Red.
introduction: A union describes a fixed set of cases. match selects an action for a case.
learningObjectives: Name a set of cases with F#

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Save each example as lesson.fsx and run dotnet fsi lesson.fsx.

blocks.title: Name a set of cases
blocks.code:
type Light = Red | Green
let light = Green
let message = match light with | Red -> "Stop" | Green -> "Go"
printfn "%s" message

blocks.text: Green matches the Green case, so the selected text is Go.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Cover every union case in a match.
